transport.redirects: error; never forward authorization on redirect
transport.credentials: server-only existing approved key; no credential discovery or OAuth start

authorization_header.name: Authorization
authorization_header.value: raw existing API key or existing pos_ token

base_urls.policy: Explicit approved base; exact origin/path allowlist. No base guessing, probing, user-info, query, fragment, path traversal or arbitrary URLs. Local HTTP requires isolated loopback approval.

endpoints.semantic: list connected organization accounts; no provider connection/refresh

response.nullable_caution: Docs do not declare required fields or nullable properties comprehensively. Pinned model allows nullable profile/picture; only selected projection required fields must be strictly validated.

endpoints.completeness: Pinned findMany returns all nondeleted organization integrations including disabled ones; no cap/order specified. Local pilot projects exactly approved ID. This is not all historical/deleted accounts or proof token is channel scoped.

endpoints.semantic: list organization root posts with date selection and recurrence expansion; read only

customer.reason: Not needed for exact channel projection; pinned spread overrides integration deletedAt/org filters.

pinned_extra_fields.releaseId: nullable string external provider release identifier; may be missing sentinel; not attempt ID
pinned_extra_fields.group: Postiz post grouping, not project/content version/attempt
pinned_extra_fields.creationMethod: source creation enum; not provenance attestation
pinned_extra_fields.actualDate: recurring rows only: original post publishDate

pagination.warning: getPostsList page/limit code is a different method NOT used by this public route.

query_semantics.recurrence: OR intervalInDays not null bypasses date predicate; expansion starts at original publishDate through endDate inclusive and ignores requested startDate; repeated original id with different publishDate; actualDate original

pilot_response_policy.date_bounds: validate absolute UTC start <= end; bounded explicit range
pilot_response_policy.channel_filter: server-side exact equality post.integration.id == preauthorized integration ID before browser projection/logging
pilot_response_policy.recurrence: exclude every non-null intervalInDays row and any actualDate row; mark partial and report excluded count. Never invent occurrence/attempt IDs. Alternative block entire response if schema cannot express omission.
pilot_response_policy.duplicates: reject duplicate remaining post IDs; no silent first/last wins
pilot_response_policy.missing_optional_recurrence_metadata: Do not assume absence proves nonrecurrence in unqualified deployments; duplicates still fail closed. Live source version remains unverified.
pilot_response_policy.date_recheck: validate every selected date and apply inclusive requested range locally; do not silently convert bad dates into valid dates
pilot_response_policy.overflow: deterministically sort selected nonrecurring rows by publishDate then id, retain at most 200, mark partial with counts; alternatively reject; never claim complete
pilot_response_policy.completeness: bounded for full successful local selection within window; partial when excluded/truncated; never complete global project snapshot

single_channel.warning: Upstream requests read organization-wide data. UI/server projection does not narrow token permissions. If org-wide data access exceeds approval, BLOCK; require existing isolated org containing only the approved channel or separate explicit authorization.
single_channel.disabled_account: recommend restricted; disabled=false is not health/token validity proof

PUBLISHED.reason: No independently established actual release timestamp in public list

ERROR.reason: post state only; no failure/attempt history

status_mapping.unknown_state: reject invalid or explicitly surface unknown in separately approved model; never coerce to published/scheduled

external_identifiers.id: Postiz post ID (local plan id), not social network publication id
external_identifiers.integration.id: Postiz integration ID, not remote social account id
external_identifiers.releaseId: pinned extra field; preserve only in separate explicitly approved provenance extension; null/empty/missing sentinel is unavailable; never parse URL to supply it
external_identifiers.releaseURL: remote URL text; not authoritative id or fetched proof. Do not auto-fetch, render HTML, embed previews, or create externalPublications without genuine attempt relationship.

errors.200: strict JSON root and field validation; malformed -> invalid, never empty success
errors.401: restricted; missing/invalid key, invalid OAuth token OR subscription missing in pinned middleware; no auto login/connect
errors.403: restricted; middleware exceptions can become forbidden
errors.404: unavailable/contract mismatch for list route, NOT empty data
errors.413: unexpected for no-body GET; report error
errors.429: bounded backoff, honor valid Retry-After if present; not guaranteed by docs
errors.5xx: bounded exponential backoff; retain failure state, never suppress as empty
errors.network_timeout: error/unavailable, bounded retry only while authorized and not aborted
errors.abort: cancel fetch/retries and never publish stale scope result
errors.response_bodies: sanitize; no raw auth headers/content to diagnostics

rate_limits.pinned_guard: only POST where url includes /public/v1/posts calls throttler; reads bypass this guard
rate_limits.policy: No claim unlimited reads or fixed 30/90 read allowance; reverse proxies/deployments may limit. Conservative configurable read budget, sequential calls, bounded retries.

live_validation_required: existing credential authorization without creating one
exact approved integration ID and local binding
live response schema incl recurrence extras
